title: Alerts
description: Get a message in a webhook or chat when credits run low, an account is banned or no account can serve requests.
channelsHint: Where alerts go. Nothing is sent until a channel is on. Channel changes save right away.
noChannels: No channels yet. Add one to start getting alerts.
removeChannelBody: Alerts stop going to this channel, and its saved URL, token and secret are deleted.
channelLimit: You can add up to {max} channels.
rulesHint: When to send an alert. Rule changes save with the Save button below.
accountUsageHint: Sends one alert when an account passes a threshold. The alert can repeat after the account's credits reset.
poolUsageHint: Credits used across all enabled accounts that are not banned.
thresholdsHint: 1 to 10 percentages from 1 to 100, in ascending order, such as 80, 90, 100. When usage passes several at once, only the highest one sends an alert.
thresholdsInvalid: Enter 1 to 10 whole percentages from 1 to 100 in ascending order.
poolCooldownHint: The minimum time between two pool alerts. It stops repeat alerts when usage hovers around a threshold.
accountBannedHint: When Kiro suspends an account or its sign-in stops working.
allUnavailableHint: When no enabled account has been able to serve requests for a minute.
dailySummaryHint: Once a day: requests, failures, credits and tokens of the last 24 hours, the busiest accounts and keys, and the accounts that need attention.
dailySummaryTimeHint: Shown in your time zone ({zone}). The server keeps {utc} UTC, so in your time it moves by an hour when daylight saving time starts or ends.
dailySummaryTimeHintNoZone: Shown in your local time. The server keeps {utc} UTC, so in your time it moves by an hour when daylight saving time starts or ends.
dailySummaryTestHint: Sends the last 24 hours now to every channel that is on. It does not count as the day's summary.
dailySummaryTestNoChannel: Add or switch on a channel first.
dailySummaryTestFailed_one: The summary did not reach {failed} of {count} channel. See its last result.
dailySummaryTestFailed_other: The summary did not reach {failed} of {count} channels. See each channel's last result.
dialogHint: Secrets are kept on the server and never shown again.
name: Name
urlHint.webhook: The alert is sent to this URL as a JSON POST.
urlHint.discord: From the Discord channel's settings: Integrations, then Webhooks.
urlHint.slack: An incoming webhook URL from your Slack app.
chatIdHint: A user, group or channel ID, or @channelname. Message the bot once first.
chatIdInvalid: Enter a chat ID or @channelname, with no spaces.
signingSecretHint: Optional. When set, each request includes {header} with an HMAC-SHA256 of the body.
secretKeep: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
urlInvalid: Enter an http:// or https:// URL.
